response.justification: Bogdan brings over 10 years of full-stack experience with deep proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK, directly aligning with the required stack. His hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure, testing frameworks (Vitest/Jest), and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) exceeds expectations, while his open-source contributions and teaching reflect strong collaboration and engineering rigor. Minor concerns include limited explicit mention of Nest.js and Kotlin/Java in recent roles, but his adaptability and breadth compensate.

Proven track record in AI-agent development and developer tooling

concerns: Nest.js not explicitly mentioned in recent roles
